sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(month = 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(month = 9, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(IIF(month = 0, 1, 0)) FROM longest_absense_from_school
SELECT T1.name FROM male T1 INNER JOIN unemployed T2 ON T1.name=T2.name INNER JOIN disabled T3 ON T1.name=T3.name INNER JOIN longest_absense_from_school T4 ON T1.name=T4.name WHERE T4.month=5
SELECT SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL,1,0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL,1,0)) FROM filed_for_bankrupcy T1 LEFT JOIN male T2 ON T1.name=T2.name

SELECT CAST((SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month = 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month = 0, 1, 0))) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.name), IIF(SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NOT NULL AND T1.month = 0, 1, 0)) - SUM(IIF(T2.name IS NULL AND T1.month = 0, 1, 0)) > 0, 'YES', 'NO') FROM longest_absense_from_school T1 LEFT JOIN disabled T2 ON T2.name = T1.name

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T4.name) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.name) FROM enlist T1 INNER JOIN enrolled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name LEFT JOIN male T4 ON T2.name=T4.name WHERE T2.school='ucla' AND T1.organ='air_force'
SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.name IN (SELECT name FROM male), 0, 1)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.name) FROM enrolled T1 INNER JOIN disabled T2 ON T1.name=T2.name WHERE T1.school='uci'
